lessons_used: Home wait_info changes (won 6 of 15), adoption redesigns (won 3 of 6), finish redesigns (won 1 of 2), adoption new_flows (won 1 of 2), sign_in notifications (won 1 of 4), and finish new_screens (won 1 of 6) generated winning tests.
Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, sign_in incentives, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect and frequently caused negative performance.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new_flows, home redesigns, and sign_in copy showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, finish reorder, home new_flow, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for major winning redesigns/flows and too high for changes that had no clear effect or negative outcomes.

Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect and frequently caused negative performance.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new_flows, home redesigns, sign_in copy, and sign_in incentives showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (e.g., adoption layout, adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path reorder, sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for major winning redesigns, reorders, and new flows.
Predictions were systematically too high for changes that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance.
